summary: KN-EB7 terminal-strip end accessory arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: KN-EB7 is the drawing identifier for terminal-strip end accessory in AutomationDirect's Konnect-It DIN-Rail Terminal Blocks collection. An end accessory locates or closes part of a terminal strip. Its selected purpose and compatibility must be checked against the chosen terminal system.

For example, in a field-terminal row that needs a defined end and service access, use the KN-EB7 reference to coordinate strip end, fastening access and adjacent marking. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Other PLC Products/Konnect-It/KN-EB7.DWG for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep strip end, fastening access and adjacent marking visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named KN-EB7 drawing and its terminal-strip end accessory role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
